# zff: AI Coding Agent Guide

`zff` (Z-FFmpeg) is a modular multimedia extension ecosystem built directly on
the industry-standard **FFmpeg** C architecture — no custom pipeline engine.
Transplanted and evolved from `zstreamer` (whose GStreamer-like `zst_*` engine
is frozen; only its algorithms are ported).

## Architecture (two tiers)

```
Application (100% standard FFmpeg API: AVFormatContext, AVFrame, AVPacket)
  ├── libzff-core.so — proprietary HW bridge (NvBufSurface/DMABUF, PTP time, SideData)
  └── zstr_* plugins — AVFormat/AVDevice devices + C processing engines
```
No `AVFilter`/`AVBitStreamFilter` implementations: out-of-tree filters are
impossible with distro libav* headers (opaque `AVFilterPad`, no formats
constructors, no `filter()` callback). Engines follow `zff_engine.h`
(`alloc`/`create` → `process` → `flush` → `free(&ptr)`), kept compatible
with a future in-tree FFmpeg port.

## Buffer rules (non-negotiable)

1. **No custom buffer types.** Raw media = `AVFrame`, compressed/RTP = `AVPacket`, both governed by `AVBufferRef` refcounts.
2. **Video/audio frames**: engines allocate output buffers with `av_frame_get_buffer()`
   (`ff_get_video_buffer()` is in-tree-only and unavailable out-of-tree).
3. **Muxers/demuxers**: `av_packet_alloc()` / `av_packet_free()`.
4. **Private metadata**: FourCC side-data tags (`ZSTR_TAG_*`), never TLV containers. `av_frame_get_side_data()` / `av_packet_get_side_data()` are O(1).
5. **PTS convention**: nanoseconds in `zstr_aresample`; stream time_base elsewhere. Never invent timestamp types.

## Build & test (Docker only)

```bash
./scripts/build-docker.sh x86   # docker/Dockerfile.x86 -> zff-build:x86
./scripts/build.sh x86          # outputs to build-x86/
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/workspace -w /workspace/build-x86 zff-build:x86 ctest --output-on-failure
./scripts/dev.sh x86            # interactive shell
```

CMake options: `BUILD_TESTS=ON`, `BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON`, `ENABLE_JETSON=OFF`,
`ENABLE_DANTE=ON`, `HAS_WEBRTC`/`HAS_SVT_JPEGXS` auto-detected.
Libraries: `libzff-core` (`src/core/`), `libzff-plugins` (`src/plugins/`).
Tests: one `tests/test_<name>.c` per plugin, registered with `add_test`.

## Install & consume

```bash
./scripts/package.sh            # dist/zff-<ver>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz (usr/ layout)
DESTDIR=/tmp/stage cmake --install build-x86   # standard GNUInstallDirs install
```
Installed: versioned `.so` + headers + `zff-core.pc`/`zff-plugins.pc` +
`zffConfig.cmake` (`find_package(zff)` → `zff::zff-plugins`). NOTE: prefix=`/`
triggers GNUInstallDirs usrmerge rewriting — package with `/usr`.

## Coding conventions

- **C11**, `zstr_*` prefix for plugins, `zff_*` for core. Snake_case.
- **Tests build with `-UNDEBUG`**, so `assert()` stays active even in Release;
  still prefer the `CHECK` macro for calls with side effects (it prints
  file:line before aborting — see `tests/test_rtsp_server.c`).
- FFmpeg device pattern: C engine (`alloc/process/free`) + `FFOutputFormat` /
  `AVInputFormat` wrapper + `AVOption` table + registration in
  `src/plugins/zff_plugins.c`. Follow `zstr_net_sink.c` as the template.
- Engine contract (`include/zff/zff_engine.h`): `free(&ptr)` NULLs the pointer;
  `process` never consumes input; option strings are `k=v:...`; stateful
  engines provide `flush()`; runtime reconfig (where supported) is `set_param`
  effective next `process()`. New engines follow it; `alloc` = option-string
  family, `create` = typed-config family.
- Errors: negative `AVERROR(...)`; success 0. No custom result codes.
- Hardware missing → constructor returns NULL + mock fallback (see
  `zstr_v4l2.c` `is_mock`), never `#error`.
- Optional dependencies degrade via `HAS_*` CMake flags, never hard-fail
  except the core FFmpeg/ALSA/GL/X11 set.

## Plugin inventory

Devices (`libavdevice`-style indev/outdev, `src/plugins/devices/`):
| Plugin | I/O | From | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zstr_videotestsrc` | indev | `video_test_src.c` | bars/gradient/checker/noise/black; `pixel_format` yuv420p/i420/yv12→420P,nv12,nv16,yuyv422,rgb24,bgr24,rgba,bgra |
| `zstr_audiotestsrc` | indev | `audio_test_src.c` | sine/noise waveforms |
| `zstr_v4l2` | indev | `v4l2_source.c` | VIDIOC_EXPBUF DMABUF export + mock; fmts yuyv/nv12/nv16/420p/rgb24/bgr24/rgb32/bgr32 |
| `zstr_v4l2_sink` | outdev | `v4l2_sink.c` | same fmts; unsupported stream fmt fails fast |
| `zstr_alsa` / `zstr_alsa_sink` | indev/outdev | `alsa_source.c` | non-blocking poll, xrun recovery, mock sine |

Audio (`src/plugins/audio/`, `AVFrame` in/out):
| Plugin | From | Key algorithm kept |
|---|---|---|
| `zstr_aresample` | `audio_resampler.c` | PTS ASRC drift (`swr_set_compensation`), +1Hz nudge, fractional `rate_numer/denom`, `flush()` |
| `zstr_amix` | `audio_mixer.c` | volume/mute/pan per input, soft-clip, `dropout_transition` ramp |

Video (`src/plugins/video/`, `AVFrame` in/out):
| Plugin | From | Key algorithm kept |
|---|---|---|
| `zstr_scale` | `video_scaler.c` | thin sws wrapper; preserves `color_range`; `align` for HW stride |
| `zstr_text_overlay` | `text_overlay.c` | FreeType OSD, timecode, PTS-window subtitles; fmts 420P/NV12/NV16/YUYV/RGB/BGR/RGBA/BGRA |
| `zstr_glsink` | `gl_sink.c` | GLX zero-copy display; native YUV420P/NV12/RGB24 shaders, sws fallback rest |
| `zstr_gl_comp` | `gl_comp_sink.c` | GPU multi-layer compositor (alpha/borders/layouts), sws input conversion |
| `zstr_x11sink` | `x11_sink.c` | X11 software display; sws into XImage (TrueColor fast path), Expose re-blit |

Streaming (`src/plugins/streaming/`, `AVPacket` in/out):
| Plugin | From | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `zstr_net_source/sink` | `net_source/sink.c` | UDP/TCP raw; thin socket wrapper |
| `zstr_rtp_payloader/depayloader` | `rtp_*.c` | H264 FU-A / H265 FU / RFC 3640 AAC; multi-NAL AU split; marker on last |
| `zstr_rtspserver` | `rtsp_server.c` | multi-client, TCP interleaved + UDP, SDP, RTCP SR |
| `zstr_srt_source/sink/parser` | `srt_*.c` | SRT transport + SubRip parser |
| `zstr_hls_sink` | `hls_sink.c` | drives native hls muxer; Annex-B→AVCC per packet |
| `zstr_webrtc*` | `webrtc_endpoint.c` + TWCC | engine + mux/demux + SDP compat + WS signaling + WHIP publish + WHEP play + webpage demo |

Broadcast (`src/plugins/broadcast/`):
| Plugin | From | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `zstr_st2110_20/30` | `st2110_20/30_*` | RFC 4175 video, AES67 PCM audio |
| `zstr_st2110_40` | `st2110_40_*` | ANC packets (ST 344 8-bit mapping), PT 100 |
| `zstr_st2110_21` | (new; zstreamer's file is a misnamed H264 payloader) | Narrow sender pacer + Wide burst mode + receiver VRX/CMAX monitor |
| `zstr_st2110_22` | `st2110_22_*` + RFC 9134 | SVT-JPEG-XS encode/decode (optional dep), codestream + slice (K=1) RTP |
| `zstr_st2022_7` | `st2110_redundancy_*` | dual-send mux (bit-identical A/B) + hitless merge dedup |
| `zstr_st2110_sdp` | `sdp_muxer` (st2110 mode) + `sdp_demuxer` | SDP generate + parse (raw fmtp, L16/L24, ts-refclk) |
| `zstr_st2022_5` | (zstreamer's fec is an unimplemented stub) | real row-XOR + column-matrix FEC encode/recovery |

## Recipes

Capture + resample + mix (all standard FFmpeg objects):
```c
zff_plugins_register_all();
AVFormatContext *cap = NULL;
avformat_open_input(&cap, "hw:0,0", zff_find_input_format("zstr_alsa"), NULL);
zstr_aresample_t *rs = zstr_aresample_alloc("out_sample_rate=48000:asrc_mode=pts");
zstr_amix_t *mix = zstr_amix_alloc("inputs=2:normalize=1:dropout_transition=0.5");
```

Publish H264 over RTSP:
```c
AVFormatContext *oc = NULL;
avformat_alloc_output_context2(&oc, zff_find_output_format("zstr_rtspserver"),
                               NULL, "rtsp://0.0.0.0:8554/live");
// add H264 video (+AAC audio) streams with codecpar ...
avformat_write_header(oc, NULL);   // binds, spawns listener
av_write_frame(oc, pkt);           // fans out to PLAYing clients
av_write_trailer(oc);
```

WebRTC call (engine + file/WS/WHIP signaling pick one):
```c
zstr_webrtc_t *a = zstr_webrtc_alloc("twcc=1"), *b = zstr_webrtc_alloc(NULL);
zstr_webrtc_add_video_track(a, ZSTR_WEBRTC_CODEC_H264, 126, 90000);
// file:  offer file <-> answer file; WS: zstr_webrtc_connect_signaling();
// WHIP:  zstr_webrtc_whip_publish(a, "http://host:8080/whip", NULL, 15000);
// WHEP:  zstr_webrtc_add_recv_video_track(b, H264, 96, 90000);
//        zstr_webrtc_whep_play(b, "http://host:8080/whep", NULL, 15000);
zstr_webrtc_send_media(a, 0, pkt);
zstr_webrtc_recv_media(b, out, &track, 200, &got);
```

ST 2110-20 send with Narrow pacing:
```c
zstr_st2110_20_payloader_process(pay20, frame, &pkts, &n);
zstr_st2110_21_frame_start(pacer, ts, n);
for (i...) { zstr_st2110_21_wait_packet(pacer); sendto(...); }
```

## What NOT to port

FFmpeg already has these — use native, do not rewrap: all standard codecs
(x264/x265/aac/opus/vp8/vp9), mp4/mpegts/flv muxers, scale/aresample/amix
basics, testsrc/sine sources, drawtext, v4l2/alsa/xv/sdl2 devices,
nvenc/vaapi/qsv, srt/tcp/udp/http protocols, hls muxer, sdp demuxer.
Port only: server-side halves (RTSP server), broadcast protocols
(ST 2110/Dante), congestion control (TWCC/GCC), drift compensation,
hardware bridges. See `PORTING_ANALYSIS.md` in the workspace (not the repo).
